mentions.name: Coding with AI
mentions.description: A self-paced course that teaches non-software engineers how to code with AI.
mentions.problem: The author couldn't find any existing courses on coding with AI for non-SWEs, so they are building one to scratch their own itch.
mentions.audience: Non-software engineers (non-SWEs) who want to learn coding with AI.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on putting together a self-paced "Coding with AI" course for non-SWE(s).

Since I could not find anything out there, I am scratching my own itch.
mentions.author: SMAAART
